BCCI Denies Reports of India-Sri Lanka ODI Match Relocation

The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) has denied reports suggesting that the first One Day International (ODI) match between India and Sri Lanka would be moved from Delhi to Ahmedabad. The match is scheduled to take place in Delhi.
